meteodyne.configuration.title: Meteodyne
tooltip.meteodyne.wind_gauge: The arrow points downwind. Spinning cups show wind speed.
tooltip.meteodyne.wind_gauge.scale: Reads local wind at your altitude, reduced by walls and roofs. Still cups mean calm; a grey dash means no direction.
gui.meteodyne.wind_sensor.scroll: Scroll or arrows: 1 m/s. Shift: 0.1 m/s. Tab: switch endpoint.
gui.meteodyne.wind_sensor.close: Close to save. The white mark shows current wind speed.
tooltip.meteodyne.thermometer: Measures the air around you, including room warmth.
tooltip.meteodyne.thermometer.scale: The dark notch marks freezing. A grey bar means no reading.
gui.meteodyne.sensor.rising: Warmer air gives a stronger signal. The thermometer scale stays fixed.
gui.meteodyne.sensor.falling: Colder air gives a stronger signal. The thermometer scale stays fixed.
gui.meteodyne.sensor.invalid: Choose two different temperatures from -100 to 200 °C.
gui.meteodyne.sensor.drag: Drag 0 and 15 endpoints. Ctrl: move both.
gui.meteodyne.sensor.scroll: Scroll or arrows: 1 °C. Shift: 0.1 °C. Tab: switch endpoint.
gui.meteodyne.sensor.close: Close to save. The white mark shows current air temperature.
death.attack.meteodyne.hail: %1$s was battered to death by hail
death.attack.meteodyne.hail.player: %1$s was battered to death by hail while fighting %2$s
